title.narrative: Programa de Fortalecimiento de las Finanzas Pblicas
Strenghthening the Public Finance Program

description.narrative: El objetivo del programa es la recuperacin de la capacidad contributiva del sistema tributario Mexicano. La estrategia estar orientada a reducir al mximo los diversos incentivos fiscales sobre todo en aquellos instrumentos que, por su estructura, cuentan con ventajas comparativas para generar ingresos de una manera menos distorsionante, como es el caso del IVA y el impuesto a la renta. Asimismo, se fortalecer la administracin tributaria mediante la simplificacin de la legislacin fiscal y el impulso al cumplimiento voluntario.

The program's objective is the recovery of the contributive capacity of the Mexican tax system. The strategy will be oriented to reduce to the maximum the various tax incentives especially in those instruments that, because of their structure, have comparative advantages to generate revenue in a less distortionary manner, such as the VAT and the income tax. Also, the tax administration will be strengthened through the simplification of tax legislation and the impulse to voluntary compliance.
